paper_metadata.title: Error-Resilient Quantum Machine Learning for Real-World Optimization Problems in Finance and Supply Chain

experiments.description: Hybrid variational quantum-classical portfolio optimization on real S&P 500 stock data, evaluated across portfolio sizes 10, 50, and 100 assets, with noise mitigation via Zero Noise Extrapolation.

algorithm.variant: Variational Quantum Eigensolver for portfolio optimization
algorithm.ansatz: parameterized quantum circuit with layers of single-qubit RY rotations and CNOT entangling gates

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary asset-selection variables z_i ∈ {0,1} are used; the paper maps portfolio optimization to a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization formulation.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Maximize returns while minimizing risk under budget constraints; Hamiltonian form given as H = -∑_i r_i z_i + ∑_{i,j} q_ij z_i z_j.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Budget constraints are handled through the QUBO formulation; no explicit penalty coefficient is reported.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: H = -∑_i r_i z_i + ∑_{i,j} q_ij z_i z_j

problem_instance.description: Portfolio optimization using historical stock data from S&P 500 companies.

dataset_specification.description: Historical stock data from S&P 500 companies; preprocessing includes normalization, outlier removal, and dimensionality reduction as described in the methods section.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Normalization, outlier removal, and dimensionality reduction; relevant features such as asset returns and risk covariance are extracted for Hamiltonian construction.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Performance compared against simulated annealing using MAPE; scalability evaluated at portfolio sizes 10, 50, and 100 assets.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Normalization, outlier removal, dimensionality reduction, feature extraction for asset returns and risk covariance.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Validation against classical benchmarks; MAPE computation.

speedup_claims.factor: better accuracy / lower MAPE than simulated annealing
speedup_claims.conditions: portfolio sizes 10, 50, and 100 assets on real S&P 500 data
speedup_claims.caveats: No statistical significance, confidence intervals, or run counts reported; improvement is shown only via MAPE values.

experiments.description: Hybrid variational quantum-classical supply chain optimization / demand forecasting on UCI Logistics data, evaluated across problem sizes 10, 50, and 100 nodes, with noise robustness analysis.

algorithm.variant: Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm for supply chain optimization
algorithm.ansatz: parameterized quantum circuit with layers of single-qubit RY rotations and CNOT entangling gates

problem_formulation.encoding_details: The supply chain problem is described as a combinatorial optimization task; the paper states that QAOA models solutions as bitstrings and optimizes configurations over time.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize transportation costs while ensuring inventory availability across multiple locations.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Implicit constraints through the combinatorial optimization formulation; no explicit penalty terms or mixer design reported.

problem_instance.description: Demand forecasting optimization in supply chain networks using logistics data.

dataset_specification.description: UCI Machine Learning Repository logistics dataset; preprocessing includes normalization, outlier removal, and dimensionality reduction as described in the methods section.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Normalization, outlier removal, and dimensionality reduction; supply quantities and logistics records are extracted for problem encoding.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Compared against genetic algorithms; computational time reported for small (10 nodes), medium (50 nodes), and large (100 nodes) problem sizes; fidelity under varying noise intensities is also assessed.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Normalization, outlier removal, dimensionality reduction, feature extraction from logistics records.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Validation against classical benchmarks; fidelity and computational time comparison.

speedup_claims.conditions: supply chain optimization on problem sizes 10, 50, and 100 nodes
speedup_claims.caveats: Speedup inferred from reported computational times; no error bars or repeated-run statistics reported.
